about: FINAL held-out intent probe v6. Written on 2026-10-25 AFTER the intent rules were frozen in commit d30cd18 and committed before it was scored. Scored once and reported as measured; no rule change follows it. Fresh shapes: slang, formal legal phrasing, imperatives without a polite marker, deletions of items in carts in three Asian languages, past-tense statements, third-party questions, and withdrawals phrased as 'never mind'.
